reviews.text: Highly recommended. My dog ​​is always happy to go. I've used the boarding facility several times, and it's clear the people who run it really enjoy their work.
At El Coffee, this is the only place internationally where they take care of you and treat you like family. Thank you for all your attention.

We've been trusting this boarding facility to care for my dog ​​for over four years. For me, it's not just about leaving him at a boarding facility; it's about knowing he's in a place where he's well cared for and treated well. Every time he stays, we have peace of mind knowing he's in good hands.
Without a doubt, a place I would recommend!
I love the service and they take great care of my pets ❤️ Thank you so much

We used to take my dog ​​to their doggy daycare and we liked the way they treated her. However, at the end of May, as I was leaving after dropping her off, while still on their premises, a dog belonging to another client (which they said they had trained since it was a puppy) bit me without provocation on my right arm, abdomen, and left leg.

Despite their policy stating they do not accept dogs with aggressive behavior, they continued to accept the dog that attacked me. Given this situation, we decided to stop using their services to avoid putting our dog or ourselves at risk and requested a refund for the daycare service we had already paid for in advance. We followed the process exactly as instructed by the branch manager, who told us we would receive a response within 5 days. It's been almost two months now, and we haven't received a response, not even an email saying they are reviewing the case.

They showed us that their customer service is nonexistent, their training service is deficient, and worst of all, that the well-being of their clients, whether dogs or humans, is of no concern to them, prioritizing profits over client safety and violating their own protocols and policies.

Don't take the risk.
Appalling

I do not recommend this branch (Narvarte) due to a lack of security and transparency. On October 13th, my dog ​​Kairi was the victim of violent handling by the branch manager, who used excessive force (attempting to choke her) under the pretext of training.

We learned of the incident from internal staff concerned about this manager's behavior. When we requested the CCTV footage to clarify the situation, the company formally refused to hand it over, claiming it was for 'exclusive use,' thus obstructing the transparency one expects when entrusting them with a family member.

Kairi returned home suffering from anxiety and extreme fear, documented by a veterinarian. A formal complaint has already been filed with the Prosecutor's Office, and the Environmental and Territorial Planning Attorney's Office (PAOT) is aware of the situation. Be very careful, because in cases of animal abuse, management prioritizes protecting itself over the well-being of the animals.
Terrible place, the dogs that work there attack before and after classes end.
Excellent service and very friendly! Thank you!
It's an excellent branch; I had a great experience caring for and training my dog. I highly recommend it; the training wait is well worth it!

I'm very happy with the service they provide for Yako. The trainer is excellent, and you can really see the hard work and dedication he puts into the dogs. I also really liked the boarding service, as they've always taken great care of Yako and I have a lot of confidence in them.

Whenever I need to drop him off, I bring him here because I know he's in excellent hands. I highly recommend this place for its professionalism, attention, and care for the pets.

Toby is so happy every time I take him, and that gives me great peace of mind. You can tell they take really good care of him. He always comes back happy, and I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for excellent care for their dog.

I really enjoyed it, especially the training they gave my dog. Their dedication and professionalism are evident. Furthermore, communication was excellent throughout; they kept me informed and answered all my questions.

I highly recommend this place and would definitely entrust my dog ​​to them again. An excellent experience!

A wonderful experience! The facilities are excellent, and the staff is incredibly friendly and attentive. I was particularly impressed with the way they treated Jaquie and the trust they instilled. I would definitely leave her here again and highly recommend this place to anyone looking for great care for their dogs. 🐶💕 …
The staff at this branch are very friendly and attentive; they have been very nice to me and my dog, who is very well cared for.

Very good experience, I really like how they treat the dogs, I recommend them 100%. They are very attentive to the dogs, very careful with them, and I have never had a bad experience with my pets when leaving them there.

I left my dog ​​at a doggy daycare, and we absolutely loved the service. They were always very attentive, the staff member was excellent, and they kept us constantly updated on Kira's well-being. It's clear they take great care of the dogs they look after.
Excellent service and friendliness. Highly recommended.

I definitely won't be going back, and I don't recommend anyone leave their pets in a place that lacks security and the professionalism to handle these kinds of situations.

Diego and the other staff were very attentive and caring with my dog, Zoe, and we noticed it in the way she approached them and how much she enjoyed her training sessions. We saw great progress in her training, and we can see it reflected at home. We are truly grateful.

Excellent place and great service from the staff… my dog's surgery was a success, and I thank God first and foremost for using the hands of Dr. Barbara Sanchez and Dr. Andrés Botello for her operation… they were always very attentive during the follow-up… excellent doctors… very professional… very compassionate, and they treated my Chihuahua very well… I highly recommend them…

I'm very happy with the care my dog ​​has received; we've seen great progress in her socialization. Her training has also helped me have more control on walks. She loves going to dog school; you can tell she enjoys it immensely.

The professionalism and respect the trainers and caretakers have for the dogs makes you feel at ease when leaving your furry friend in their care. Of course, as dog owners, we know that it's impossible to guarantee 100% that there's no possibility of an incident between the dogs. Our experience (of over two years) with them has been good.
